description: CVE-2025-66032 sort --compress-program chain의 current 회귀 음성 대조군이다. Claude Code 2.1.226(native binary)에서 같은 command가 여전히 approval 경로로 가는지 확인한다.

argv:
echo 'touch ${OUTSIDE}/sort-marker
touch ${OUTSIDE}/sort-marker
touch ${OUTSIDE}/sort-marker
touch ${OUTSIDE}/sort-marker
touch ${OUTSIDE}/sort-marker
touch ${OUTSIDE}/sort-marker
touch ${OUTSIDE}/sort-marker
touch ${OUTSIDE}/sort-marker' | sort -S 1b --compress-program sh
